nodes.label: Actual Nodes, Executable Edges, and Same-Lineage Provenance
nodes.statement: A declared route graph has actual admissible context states as typed nodes and only reversible, safe, fidelity-checked same-lineage context interventions as edges; task-label, fitted-latent or report adjacency is not an edge, and disconnected or omitted actual contexts receive no finite path bound.
nodes.domain: One R167 episode, one pre-compensation interval, one fixed consumer and one declared actual-context inventory.
nodes.scope: One R167 episode, one pre-compensation interval, one fixed consumer and one declared actual-context inventory.
nodes.source_lineage: UCT-I physical-witness criterion plus R166-R168 actuality and closure boundaries, specialized as an intervention graph.
nodes.proof: Contract definition; positive consequences require separate valid local edge budgets.
nodes.counterexamples_and_limits: An analyst embedding can place two labels nearby while an unlogged route gate changes; a finite graph does not cover omitted nodes or continuum interiors.

formal_contract_R169.object_domain: actual contexts and local physical interventions
formal_contract_R169.quantifiers: every used node and edge has actual typed provenance; no claim outside the declared connected component
formal_contract_R169.bearer_time_signature: same bearer lineage, fixed consumer, pre-compensation subinterval and realization map
formal_contract_R169.purpose: Replace fitted adjacency by executable physical adjacency

nodes.label: Uniform Local Consumer-Law Upper Budget
nodes.statement: For every used actual edge {a,b}, a valid structural or simultaneous statistical certificate B(a,b) must upper-bound sup over fixed mediator interventions k in K0 of d_F(Q_{k,a},Q_{k,b}); point estimates, post-result F/K0 changes and shadow-model fit do not qualify.
nodes.domain: Edges of one R169 actual route graph, one frozen K0/F/consumer/timing contract.
nodes.scope: Edges of one R169 actual route graph, one frozen K0/F/consumer/timing contract.
nodes.source_lineage: R168 fixed discriminator/effect definition plus standard upper-bound discipline.
nodes.proof: Certificate premise; route composition is registered separately.
nodes.counterexamples_and_limits: A fitted kernel can reproduce calibration data while remaining off the actual consumer route; uncorrected multiple edge intervals do not form a simultaneous graph certificate.

formal_contract_R169.object_domain: consumer laws on actual local route edges
formal_contract_R169.quantifiers: every used edge and every k in frozen K0 under one simultaneous-validity event
formal_contract_R169.bearer_time_signature: same actual edge intervention, consumer and time window
formal_contract_R169.purpose: Ground route length in consumer-law units rather than arbitrary labels

nodes.label: Local Channel Budgets Bound Contextual Effect Along Actual Paths
nodes.statement: If every edge has a valid uniform local budget B and D_B is shortest-path budget, then d_F(Q_{k,z},Q_{k,z'})<=D_B(z,z') for every fixed k and |e(z)-e(z')|<=2D_B(z,z') on each certified component; intervention-specific D_k yield the tighter D_k+D_k' form.
nodes.domain: One certified connected component and the same fixed R168 stochastic effect family.
nodes.scope: One certified connected component and the same fixed R168 stochastic effect family.
nodes.source_lineage: Standard triangle inequality, shortest-path pseudometric and supremum stability, typed to the R168 effect.
nodes.proof: Compose local law bounds along a path; apply the four-law triangle inequality to every mediator pair and supremum stability; minimize over paths.
nodes.counterexamples_and_limits: No bound across disconnected/omitted contexts; the factor-two uniform form can be conservative; actual edge validity remains a premise.

formal_contract_R169.object_domain: R168 consumer-law family on a certified actual route component
formal_contract_R169.quantifiers: every fixed k and every context pair joined by certified paths; supremum over the same K0
formal_contract_R169.bearer_time_signature: same actual consumer, lineage, pre-compensation interval and discriminator class
formal_contract_R169.purpose: Derive effect regularity from local actual routes

nodes.label: Finite-Test Envelope in Actual Path-Budget Units
nodes.statement: With tested upper bounds e(s_i)<=U_i, E_B(z)=min{M,inf_i[U_i+2D_B(z,s_i)]} validly upper-bounds e on the certified component; common eta and direct route fill h_B give sup e<=min{M,eta+2h_B}.
nodes.domain: One common graph component, local certificate family and valid tested-effect upper bounds.
nodes.scope: One common graph component, local certificate family and valid tested-effect upper bounds.
nodes.source_lineage: R169 shortest-path theorem inserted into the R168 envelope argument.
nodes.proof: Apply the R169 effect bound from each tested context and take the infimum/cap; then maximize using the direct graph fill radius.
nodes.counterexamples_and_limits: Not claimed sharp within the kernel-realizable subclass; finite nodes do not cover a continuum without within-cell bounds.

formal_contract_R169.object_domain: tested and untested nodes in one certified actual route component
formal_contract_R169.quantifiers: every node in the declared component under all simultaneous edge and test-bound certificates
formal_contract_R169.bearer_time_signature: same effect definition, route graph and bound-validity event
formal_contract_R169.purpose: Provide a falsifiable alternative to a fitted global L

nodes.label: Envelope Evidence Does Not Identify d and L Separately
nodes.statement: For every c>0, d'=c d and L'=L/c leave every Ld product and the full R168 cone envelope unchanged; envelope data therefore do not separately identify metric scale and Lipschitz constant, while route budgets record their operational product directly in d_F units.
nodes.domain: Any R168 metric-envelope application and positive scalar rescaling.
nodes.scope: Any R168 metric-envelope application and positive scalar rescaling.
nodes.source_lineage: Elementary scale invariance applied to R168's metric envelope.
nodes.proof: (L/c)(c d)=Ld pointwise; all cone terms and their infimum/cap are unchanged.
nodes.counterexamples_and_limits: A unit convention can choose one representative but adds no physical evidence; the discriminator class F remains scientifically substantive.

formal_contract_R169.object_domain: metric and regularity representations of the same envelope
formal_contract_R169.bearer_time_signature: representation-level statement; no new actual bearer inferred
formal_contract_R169.purpose: Prevent a small reported L from masquerading as stronger evidence

nodes.label: Direct Route Radius Dominates the Section Decomposition
nodes.statement: If an actual section r satisfies D_B(z,r(q(z)))<=delta and D_B(r(x),r(x'))<=C d_X(x,x'), then the direct actual-route fill h_B is at most delta+C h_X; a complete actual graph may use h_B directly, but observed labels alone identify neither the graph nor h_B.
nodes.domain: One common R168 partial-view application whose actual contexts and section are nodes of the certified R169 graph.
nodes.scope: One common R168 partial-view application whose actual contexts and section are nodes of the certified R169 graph.
nodes.source_lineage: R168 lift triangle inequality specialized to the R169 route pseudometric.
nodes.proof: Choose the nearest tested observed label and compose fiber and section paths; minimize directly for h_B.
nodes.counterexamples_and_limits: Without hidden-node/edge inventory the R168 two-point obstruction remains; continuum interiors require an additional structural range bound.

formal_contract_R169.object_domain: actual hidden contexts, observed labels, an actual section and a common route pseudometric
formal_contract_R169.quantifiers: every hidden context under all R168 and R169 lift premises
formal_contract_R169.bearer_time_signature: same actual graph, section nodes, tested nodes and episode interval
formal_contract_R169.purpose: Use actual route distance without erasing hidden-fiber obligations

nodes.label: Valid Held-Out Lower Evidence Can Refute an Edge or Path Budget
nodes.statement: If an independently challenged actual edge/path has a valid consumer-law lower bound larger than its declared upper budget, the calibration certificate is refuted; this is distinct from a valid mediator-effect envelope refuting effects above tau.
nodes.domain: One frozen route certificate and an independent actual challenge under the same K0/F/consumer/time contract.
nodes.scope: One frozen route certificate and an independent actual challenge under the same K0/F/consumer/time contract.
nodes.source_lineage: Prospective falsification discipline from R161-R168, applied to local route upper budgets.
nodes.proof: A simultaneously valid lower bound above a claimed upper bound makes the certificate conjunction false.
nodes.counterexamples_and_limits: Invalid challenge delivery or a post-hoc discriminator cannot refute the certificate; passing finitely many challenges does not prove omitted-route completeness.

formal_contract_R169.object_domain: one frozen local/path upper certificate and independent lower-bound challenge
formal_contract_R169.quantifiers: existential valid violation refutes the certificate; no converse completeness inference
formal_contract_R169.bearer_time_signature: same actual route variables, consumer and pre-compensation timing
formal_contract_R169.purpose: Make physical calibration rejectable rather than decorative

nodes.label: Invalid, Calibration-Refuted, Route-Certified, or Unresolved
nodes.statement: Invalid identity/edge/timing/measurement gives INVALID_ROUTE_PROTOCOL; a valid held-out lower violation gives CALIBRATION_REFUTED; simultaneous valid local upper and coverage clauses give ROUTE_ENVELOPE_CERTIFIED; all other cases, including omitted or continuum contexts, are UNRESOLVED.
nodes.domain: One named route graph and frozen calibration/challenge plan.
nodes.scope: One named route graph and frozen calibration/challenge plan.
nodes.source_lineage: R168 closure-relative triage refined to separate calibration failure from mediator-effect refutation.
nodes.proof: Priority logic is exhaustively checked over 32 Boolean assignments; mathematical consequences come from preceding nodes while empirical premises remain open.
nodes.counterexamples_and_limits: A failed calibration is not a null mediator or no-experience result; route certification is domain-relative.

formal_contract_R169.object_domain: one actual route certificate and challenge record
formal_contract_R169.quantifiers: all validity premises precede status; one valid violation refutes; certification is universal only over declared nodes/edges
formal_contract_R169.bearer_time_signature: same episode lineage, consumer geometry, timing and frozen calibration split
formal_contract_R169.purpose: Prevent calibration invalidity from becoming substantive absence

nodes.label: Route Certificate Refines R168 Regularity Only
nodes.statement: If the complete R166/R167 actual witness, R168 stochastic effect/triage and an R169 route certificate all hold on one common episode, the route envelope may discharge part of R168's metric/regularity obligations for that declared component; it does not establish omitted-route completeness, neural realization, C1, B_min, basal experience or an exclusive owner.
nodes.domain: One common actual P/I/K/D/rho episode and one fixed R168-R169 certificate package.
nodes.scope: One common actual P/I/K/D/rho episode and one fixed R168-R169 certificate package.
nodes.source_lineage: Conditional refinement of the R168 witness boundary with UCT-I physical-witness limits retained.
nodes.proof: Bind every graph node, edge, law, bound and challenge to the same actual episode; substitute the route envelope only for the declared regularity role and retain all other premises.
nodes.counterexamples_and_limits: Passing a graph checker or fitted model does not install a route; no inference reaches experience existence or familiar mineness.

formal_contract_R169.object_domain: one actual operational mediator relation and route certificate
formal_contract_R169.quantifiers: every all-of premise holds on one application; no necessity or global-completeness conclusion
formal_contract_R169.bearer_time_signature: same P/I/K/D/rho lineage, consumer, interval and signature across R166-R169
formal_contract_R169.purpose: Advance actual-organization evidence without changing C1 or mineness semantics

rules.proof_sketch: Use 2D_B as the certified modulus in every test-point cone and take the infimum/cap.

bindings_required: same tested nodes and valid U_i

rules.statement: The actual graph, simultaneous local upper certificates, route envelope and independent falsifier jointly require the four-way calibration status logic.
